name: REFINER_FAILURE
definition: dedicated refiner does not create enough positive action opportunity
consequence_if_triggered: report as a failure; routing has nothing to route

name: ROUTER_FAILURE
definition: learned paired gain fails to outperform simple GT-free routing signals out of sample

name: PRESERVATION_FAILURE
definition: routed system materially degrades the global reference

name: RESOURCE_FAILURE
definition: router/refiner cost removes the useful compute-performance trade-off

name: DOMAIN_COLLAPSE
definition: benefit is concentrated in one domain while another is materially harmed
consequence_if_triggered: report per-domain harm; macro average may not hide it

name: H1_SUPPORTED
definition: learned pre-execution GT-free predictor beats simple proxies at equal budget
consequence_if_triggered: enables scoped Level-2 wording for the integrated residual

name: PRESERVATION_SATISFIED
definition: lower bound of Delta > -0.005 on macro-domain Dice and no domain collapse

name: FRONTIER_MEASURED
definition: a measurable accuracy-compute frontier exists across budget points
